HomePage.title: Damn cool places in Amsterdam.
HomePage.subtitle: Forget the laminated top tens and the 'authentic Amsterdam' racket. dam.cool chases rooms that still have a pulse - coffee worth walking for, crates of vinyl you actually dig through, art with teeth, nights that outlast the last tram, and corners this city hasn't packaged for the feed yet.
HomePage.aboutBody: No noise, no endless lists. Just places worth your time. Fast, visual and easy to browse.
HomePage.contactBody: Know a place that belongs here? Send a short recommendation.
